She discusses why AI infrastructure spending remains strong, the growing focus on proving returns from that investment and why she still views Anthropic’s record IPO as a success despite shares falling below their offering price. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fed Beige Book Shows Moderate Growth, Uptick in Wage Pressures
general.summary: Most Federal Reserve districts saw slight to moderate growth in recent weeks, and companies reported increased wage pressures, according to a survey of the central bank’s regional contacts.

Can US Chip Controls Slow China’s AI Progress?
general.summary: Nvidia is at the center of a renewed debate over how much access China should have to advanced US AI chips. CSIS’s Emily Harding discusses whether export controls can meaningfully slow China’s AI progress without accelerating its domestic chip industry, what lawmakers should ask Jensen Huang when he testifies before Congress, and why technology companies increasingly need to think of themselves as potential national security targets. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (

general.title: US Genesis Mission Looks to AI to Accelerate Science
general.summary: One year after the launch of the Genesis Mission, the US Department of Energy says the AI-driven initiative has grown to nearly 300 research projects spanning energy, biology, advanced manufacturing and national security. general.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles in ‘Sell First’ Mode
general.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at markets as the Nasdaq 100 touches bear-market territory with traders dumping tech shares. Plus, Nvidia shares also tumble after the return of CEO Jensen Huang, with the stock remaining down 35% from its October 6 peak; and Under Secretary of Energy Dario Gil joins to discuss AI's role in national security on the one-year anniversary of President Trump's Genesis Mission. (Source: Bloomberg)
